title: Northgate+ Business Cash Earning Schedule: Posting Entry
content:
**Scope.** For the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first, when the member holds a Northgate+ Business membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, and only for that line, the Northgate Cash posted is worked out under this Business earning schedule. The result is one Northgate Cash earning on the Business membership's ledger, which raises its Northgate Cash balance.

## Posting tool `post_business_cash_earning_affdfb03`

**What the tool does.** It posts the Northgate Cash a Northgate+ Business member earned on one fulfilled Northgate order line. One call books one earning entry on the membership's Northgate Cash ledger, linked to the order and to the order line that earned it, and raises the membership's Northgate Cash balance by the amount posted. The business sees the new earning in their Northgate Cash history and the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_business_cash_earning_affdfb03` and then calls it. Success is a receipt reporting status "posted".

**Parameters**

1. `membership_id` — identifier of the membership record that receives the Northgate Cash, as returned by the membership lookup for the member.
2. `order_id` — identifier of the Northgate order the earning line belongs to, as returned by the order lookup.
3. `line_event_id` — the order line identifier (the line's own record identifier) that earned the Northgate Cash, as returned by the order ledger lookup.
4. `earn_date` — the business date the earning posts on, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time part, no time zone); never empty.
5. `basis_amount_usd` — the line amount the earning percentage was applied to, in US dollars as a positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are refused, never rounded by the tool.
6. `amount_usd` — the Northgate Cash posted, in US dollars as a positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are refused, never rounded by the tool.

**Receipt.** "Northgate Cash earning <earning_ref> posted: membership <membership_id>, order <order_id>, line <line_event_id>, earned on <earn_date>, basis <basis_amount_usd> USD, amount <amount_usd> USD, new balance <balance> USD, status posted." The earning reference identifies the new entry; amounts are two-decimal US dollars; the balance after the posting may be negative.

**Refusals.** A text beginning "Error:" means nothing was posted because an argument broke the formats above, the membership's tier is outside this posting (any tier other than Northgate+ Business), the line is not the earliest-recorded line of the member's Northgate order with the latest fulfilled date among their orders in fulfilled status, or the membership reference is unknown.
